headline: NFL SNF: Derrick Henry runs wild as Ravens dismantle previously unbeaten Bills 35-10
whyCareReason: Derrick Henry delivers a historic 199-yard rushing display to hand the high-flying Buffalo Bills their first defeat of the season in an emphatic statement win for Baltimore.
teaser: FINAL: Baltimore Ravens 35, Buffalo Bills 10. Derrick Henry erupts for an 87-yard opening touchdown and 199 total rushing yards as Lamar Jackson outduels Josh Allen.
story:
Why this one matters: M&T Bank Stadium witnessed a complete tactical demolition on Sunday night as the Baltimore Ravens dismantled the previously undefeated Buffalo Bills 35-10 in a statement AFC victory.

On Baltimore's very first offensive snap, Derrick Henry took a handoff, burst through a crease on the right side, and outran Buffalo's secondary for an explosive 87-yard touchdown. Henry was relentless all evening, bruising through tackles for 199 rushing yards and two touchdowns on 24 carries. Lamar Jackson complemented the ground barrage with surgical efficiency, completing 13 of 18 passes for two touchdowns while adding a rushing score of his own.

Buffalo's top-ranked offense had no answers against Baltimore's physical defense. Josh Allen was pressured on 44 percent of dropbacks, sacked three times, and stripped of the football by Kyle Van Noy. The win improves Baltimore to 2-2 while dropping Buffalo to 3-1.
stakes: Baltimore climbs back to .500 and proves their championship credentials, while Buffalo suffers their first setback of 2026.
rivalryAngle: Jackson moves ahead 4-3 in head-to-head meetings against Allen, reminding the league of Baltimore's unmatched rushing prowess.
